object_types.name: Patient
object_types.definition: A person who books appointments at the clinic.

source_references.excerpt: Patients book appointments. Every appointment is booked by exactly one patient, and a patient can have many appointments.
Patients have a patient ID -- it's on their card.

object_types.name: Doctor
object_types.definition: A clinician who sees patients in appointments.

source_references.excerpt: Each appointment is with exactly one doctor. Doctors see many patients across their appointments.
Doctors have a license number.

object_types.name: Appointment
object_types.definition: A scheduled visit between a patient and a doctor at a specific date and time slot.

source_references.excerpt: Appointments get an appointment number when they're created.

object_types.name: ExamRoom
object_types.definition: A physical room in the clinic used for examinations.

source_references.excerpt: Exam rooms have a room number.

object_types.name: PatientId
object_types.definition: The identifying number for a patient, found on their card.

source_references.excerpt: Patients have a patient ID -- it's on their card.

object_types.name: LicenseNumber
object_types.definition: The identifying license number for a doctor.

source_references.excerpt: Doctors have a license number.

object_types.name: AppointmentNumber
object_types.definition: The identifying number assigned to an appointment when created.

source_references.excerpt: Appointments get an appointment number when they're created.

object_types.name: RoomNumber
object_types.definition: The identifying number for an exam room.

source_references.excerpt: Exam rooms have a room number.

object_types.name: Specialty
object_types.definition: The medical specialty of a doctor, e.g. cardiology or general practice.

source_references.excerpt: Every doctor has exactly one specialty, like cardiology or general practice.

object_types.name: AppointmentDate
object_types.definition: The calendar date on which an appointment is scheduled.

source_references.excerpt: Every appointment is on a date and at a time slot

object_types.name: TimeSlot
object_types.definition: A fixed time slot for booking appointments, e.g. 09:00 or 09:30.

source_references.excerpt: we book in fixed slots like 09:00 or 09:30

object_types.name: AppointmentStatus
object_types.definition: The current status of an appointment.

source_references.excerpt: The status is one of: scheduled, checked-in, completed, or cancelled.

object_types.name: VisitReason
object_types.definition: The reason a patient gives when booking an appointment.

source_references.excerpt: An appointment can have a visit reason the patient gives when booking

object_types.name: FollowUpNote
object_types.definition: A note attached by the doctor after the visit.

source_references.excerpt: after the visit the doctor can attach a follow-up note. At most one follow-up note per appointment.
